meta.homeDesc: Design, installation and service of ventilation and air-conditioning systems. Free site visit and estimate across Tashkent.

hero.subtitle: ACV designs, installs and services air systems in Tashkent. Site visit, measurements and a detailed quote — free of charge.

home.servicesLead: From design to warranty service — one team for everything.
home.step1x: You reach us by phone or through the site — an engineer clarifies the task.
home.step2x: A specialist takes measurements on site and records the technical conditions.
home.step3x: We prepare a precise proposal: equipment selection, estimate and timeline.
home.step4x: We complete the work on schedule, tune the system and hand over the site.
home.galleryLead: Snapshots from installations and finished systems.
home.videosTitle: See the process with your own eyes
home.why1x: Calculations for every site: air exchange, capacity, noise level.
home.why2x: Written warranty on both equipment and installation work.
home.why3x: We stay with you after installation: maintenance, diagnostics and repair.
home.why4x: A deadline fixed in the contract is a commitment for us.
home.ctaText: Leave your number — our engineer will call you today with a free consultation.

about.lead: ACV is an engineering company for air systems.
about.storyTitle: We work with air — with engineering precision
about.story1: ACV designs, installs and maintains ventilation and air-conditioning systems for offices, retail spaces, production facilities and residential buildings.
about.story2: Our principle is simple: accurate calculations, quality equipment and tidy installation. That is why most of our clients come to us by referral.
about.value1x: Precision in calculations and deadlines is the foundation of every project.
about.value2x: Only trusted brands and proven installation technology.
about.value3x: The estimate and the process are always in front of you — no hidden costs.
about.value4x: We stand behind every delivered system with warranty and service.
